blocks.content:
The Supreme Court is located in New Delhi.
However, the Chief Justice of India may appoint other places for sittings with Presidential approval.
The Supreme Court is located in New Delhi.

items: Exams frequently ask who holds the power to appoint other places for Supreme Court sittings: It is the Chief Justice of India, not the Parliament.
Always remember that Presidential approval is a mandatory requirement before the Chief Justice can appoint an alternate seat or sitting place.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Supreme Court of India is permanently located in New Delhi.
The Chief Justice of India is authorized to declare other places as sittings for the Supreme Court.
The Chief Justice can only appoint alternative places for sittings after obtaining approval from the President of India.
